evals.name: underspecified-shopkeeper
evals.prompt: I need a shopkeeper for an apothecary in the Silver District of Thalyra. Low detail is fine.
evals.expected_output: A short NPC stub with race/role/location, a few flavor lines, and a stat block (probably Commoner-derived). Should ask for CR (if not inferred) and offer name suggestions. Should wiki-link [[Thalyra]] and the apothecary's affiliation if applicable. Should ground in actual Thalyra district lore.

evals.name: named-watchful-warden-officer
evals.prompt: Create Lieutenant Halric Vesh — a male human officer in the Watchful Wardens of Thalyra, currently stationed at the Bronze Bastion. Medium detail, CR 3.
evals.expected_output: Medium-length NPC with appearance, personality, role bullets, faction tie to [[The Watchful Wardens of Thalyra]] and [[The Bronze Bastion]]. Stat block at CR 3, probably reskinned Veteran or Knight. Should NOT ask for name (given) but may ask for any other gaps. Tone should match Captain Seressa Varn's note.

evals.name: high-detail-mysterious-cleric
evals.prompt: I want a high-detail NPC: a half-elf cleric of Mystra in her 50s who runs a small shrine on the outskirts of Dornthalm. She knows something about the Dornthalm Vaults that nobody else does. CR 5.
evals.expected_output: Full Seressa-style treatment: appearance, demeanor, multi-paragraph history, an actual hook involving the [[Dornthalm Vaults]] secret. CR 5 stat block reskinned from Priest with cleric spells (Mystra-flavored). Multiple [[wiki-links]] to verified campaign entities ([[Dornthalm]], [[Mystra]], [[Dornthalm Vaults]], possibly [[The Shattered Age]]). Should offer 3 name suggestions since none was given.
